courses.title: Forklifting Operations — Level 2
courses.subject: Logistics & Operations
courses.description: Forklifting Operations Level 2 is designed to provide students with intermediate skills and knowledge required to safely operate forklifts in industrial, warehouse, and logistics environments. The course emphasizes safe handling practices, equipment maintenance, load management, and workplace efficiency.
learningOutcomes: Operate basic load shifting and lifting equipment
Plan and undertake a routine task
courses.prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; a basic command of English and numeracy is recommended.
